Author: Tataru-business
Name: Keybound Automation
Description: Reads Keybound Brawler prompts and answers with keyboard input. Open /tatarubrawler for the Keybound Automation interface. Auto queue on lobby entry repeats until Stop auto queue; the circular arrows start a counted manual loop. Diagnostic recording, automatic play, and play on MapID 1359 are enabled at startup.
Punchline: Automatically type Keybound Brawler prompts and optionally keep queueing.
Changelog:
## 1.0.8.23

- Improve disable/update cleanup: stop callbacks first, attempt remaining cleanup after an error, and ignore repeated shutdown calls.
- Keep attempting key release and IME restoration even if another shutdown step fails.
